# EcoBox workspace notes

- The current app is a frontend-only Next.js prototype using TypeScript, App Router, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide icons.
- Keep user-facing copy in Russian and prioritize mobile layouts.
- Demo listings, favorites, and reservations are local-only. Do not add Telegram bot, webhook, API, authentication, or backend integrations until the user provides requirements and credentials.
- Run `npm run build` to validate production compilation. Run `npm run dev` to launch the local app.
